description: This file implements the ServiceAdministrator class, which manages registration, instantiation, and lifecycle of services within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes methods for registering/unregistering services, creating service instances, and managing library references.

classes.name: ServiceAdministrator
classes.description: Manages service registration, instantiation, and library lifecycle within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a service with given metadata and factory, ensuring it is only registered once.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a service based on its metadata and factory.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton instance of ServiceAdministrator.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Creates an instance of a service based on its name, version, and interface number, within a specified library.

methods.name: ReleaseLibrary
methods.description: Adds a library reference to the unreferenced list for later cleanup.

methods.name: FlushLibraries
methods.description: Clears all unreferenced libraries, allowing cleanup.
